title: How Sink Drainage Works: Gravity and Venting
description: Proper sink drainage relies on more than just gravity pulling wastewater down the waste arm. A functioning drainage system requires an integrated network of fixture traps and vent pipes working together seamlessly. The P-trap holds a standing water seal that prevents dangerous sewer gases from entering the living space, while the vent stack equalizes air pressure behind the moving water column. Without adequate venting, drainage can become sluggish, and pressure fluctuations can siphon the water right out of the trap. Mastering this balance is foundational for effective plumbing installation and troubleshooting.

How Sink Drainage Works: Gravity and Venting

Proper sink drainage relies on more than just gravity pulling wastewater down the waste arm. A functioning drainage system requires an integrated network of fixture traps and vent pipes working together seamlessly. The P-trap holds a standing water seal that prevents dangerous sewer gases from entering the living space, while the vent stack equalizes air pressure behind the moving water column. Without adequate venting, drainage can become sluggish, and pressure fluctuations can siphon the water right out of the trap. Mastering this balance is foundational for effective plumbing installation and troubleshooting.
